rows.unit_db9: degrees (DOCUMENTED: paper + data range; no unit symbol in the paper)
rows.unit_conversion: explicit pi/180 in the DB9 adapter; none on the emg2pose side
rows.positive_emg2pose: flexion (DOCUMENTED + VERIFIED-EXEC: 15/15 FE joints move the fingertip toward the palm at +limit)
rows.zero_db9: the released calibrated angles are relative to the documented reference posture: hand resting on the table, fingers closed together and extended, taken from the central part of movement 11 (DOCUMENTED)
rows.zero_emg2pose: the official 20D zero vector, whose FK pose is a fingers-extended hand; joint limits are minimised at 0 for the PIP/DIP joints (DOCUMENTED + PROJECT-INFERRED from FK)
rows.reference_pose_equivalence: the two documented zero configurations are the same physical posture (fingers extended and together).  MEASURED: the DB9 reference posture (movement 11, central phase) has mean |angle| 0.854 deg over 16 dimensions, and movement 11 is the DB9 corpus's own closest-to-zero movement in two of three source databases.  The emg2pose zero is 0 by construction.
rows.angle_convention: both are joint rotation magnitudes about a fixed joint-specific axis: emg2pose via so3_exp_map(axis * angle) (CODE-INFERRED), DB9 via a linearly calibrated glove sensor reporting the joint angle in degrees (DOCUMENTED that the values are 'calibrated joint angles', not interior geometric angles)
rows.range_wrapping: emg2pose: no wrapping, not clamped to joint_limits (CODE-INFERRED + VERIFIED-EXEC).  DB9: no wrapping; the values are an unbounded linear extrapolation of the sensor and DO exceed physical ranges (MEASURED)
rows.handedness: emg2pose releases left and right sessions and flips the EMG sign for left hands; the joint angles are in the model frame.  DB9 has NO side field; the protocol instructed the right hand, and the DB9 page's Handedness column is the participant's own handedness, not the recording side (DOCUMENTED).  The two corpora therefore both hold right-hand poses, but 3 of the emg2pose mini sessions are left-hand recordings whose poses are mirrored into the same model frame.
rows.calibration_semantics: DB9: a per-channel linear map from the raw CyberGlove signal to anatomical degrees, whose gains came from a 10-subject calibration protocol and were then applied to all 77 subjects (DOCUMENTED).  emg2pose: no sensor calibration; the values are the output of an IK fit of the generic UmeTrack hand model to motion-capture data (PROJECT-INFERRED from the official pipeline)

A_anatomical_dof.basis: the two sides select the same named anatomical DOF by name; the DB9 channel vocabulary is read from each file's own order_of_angles and matches the official table in all 77 protocol files (DOCUMENTED + MEASURED)

B_joint_indexing.basis: indexing differs (emg2pose 0-19 interleaved, DB9 0-21 with the DIP block at the end) and is resolved by NAME, never positionally; verified bit-exact (MEASURED)

C_unit.basis: degrees vs radians, converted explicitly; the conversion reproduces the stored corpus to 4.4e-16 rad (MEASURED)

D_positive_direction.basis: 15 FE channels agree in sign per the paper's Table 6; the one AA channel is sign-flipped by the frozen transform (DOCUMENTED)

E_zero_definition.basis: both place zero at the extended, fingers-together hand (DOCUMENTED + MEASURED: DB9 reference posture mean |angle| 0.854 deg)

F_reference_pose.basis: the documented reference postures are the same physical configuration; all three DB9 source databases agree on it to within 11.2 deg per-joint and 0.84 deg in median (MEASURED)

G_angle_convention.basis: both are joint rotation magnitudes, not derived interior angles (DOCUMENTED for DB9 'calibrated joint angles'; CODE-INFERRED for emg2pose so3_exp_map)

H_range_wrapping.basis: neither dataset wraps; neither clamps.  DB9 produces out-of-physical-range values by linear extrapolation, which is a calibration property, not a wrapping convention (MEASURED)

I_handedness.basis: DB9 is a right-hand protocol; the emg2pose mini corpus contains 15 left and 15 right recordings.  The project's frozen contract treats the 20D vector as model-frame and does not mirror it, and no LEFT-vs-RIGHT handedness transform is applied anywhere.  Whether the UmeTrack model frame is handedness-invariant for the LEFT recordings is NOT established by this audit

J_preprocessing_calibration.basis: the two numbers are produced by fundamentally different processes: a linear sensor calibration whose gains came from 10 other subjects, versus an IK fit of a generic hand model.  This is the strongest single source of per-dimension numerical disagreement (MEASURED below)

The two corpora therefore both hold right-hand poses, but 3 of the emg2pose mini sessions are left-hand recordings whose poses are mirrored into the same model frame.
rows.calibration_semantics: DB9: a per-channel linear map from the raw CyberGlove signal to anatomical degrees, whose gains came from a 10-subject calibration protocol and were then applied to all 77 subjects (DOCUMENTED).  emg2pose: no sensor calibration; the values are the output of an IK fit of the generic UmeTrack hand model to motion-capture data (PROJECT-INFERRED from the official pipeline)

A_anatomical_dof.basis: the two sides select the same named anatomical DOF by name; the DB9 channel vocabulary is read from each file's own order_of_angles and matches the official table in all 77 protocol files (DOCUMENTED + MEASURED)

B_joint_indexing.basis: indexing differs (emg2pose 0-19 interleaved, DB9 0-21 with the DIP block at the end) and is resolved by NAME, never positionally; verified bit-exact (MEASURED)

C_unit.basis: degrees vs radians, converted explicitly; the conversion reproduces the stored corpus to 4.4e-16 rad (MEASURED)

D_positive_direction.basis: 15 FE channels agree in sign per the paper's Table 6; the one AA channel is sign-flipped by the frozen transform (DOCUMENTED)

E_zero_definition.basis: both place zero at the extended, fingers-together hand (DOCUMENTED + MEASURED: DB9 reference posture mean |angle| 0.854 deg)

F_reference_pose.basis: the documented reference postures are the same physical configuration; all three DB9 source databases agree on it to within 11.2 deg per-joint and 0.84 deg in median (MEASURED)

G_angle_convention.basis: both are joint rotation magnitudes, not derived interior angles (DOCUMENTED for DB9 'calibrated joint angles'; CODE-INFERRED for emg2pose so3_exp_map)

H_range_wrapping.basis: neither dataset wraps; neither clamps.  DB9 produces out-of-physical-range values by linear extrapolation, which is a calibration property, not a wrapping convention (MEASURED)

I_handedness.basis: DB9 is a right-hand protocol; the emg2pose mini corpus contains 15 left and 15 right recordings.  The project's frozen contract treats the 20D vector as model-frame and does not mirror it, and no LEFT-vs-RIGHT handedness transform is applied anywhere.  Whether the UmeTrack model frame is handedness-invariant for the LEFT recordings is NOT established by this audit

J_preprocessing_calibration.basis: the two numbers are produced by fundamentally different processes: a linear sensor calibration whose gains came from 10 other subjects, versus an IK fit of a generic hand model.  This is the strongest single source of per-dimension numerical disagreement (MEASURED below)
